table.retrieve:
SELECT  
	invoicecode=gldetail.invoicecode,
	invdate=GetDate(),
	NetAmt=0.00,
	OutStandingAmt=gldetail.OutStandingAmt,
	fullcode=accounts.aliasname,
	acccode=gldetail.acccode,
	chkno=gldetail.chkno,
	remarks=gldetail.remarks,
	glvochcode=gldetail.glvochcode ,
	regno = (SELECT regno FROM Patient WHERE Patient.PatientCode = gldetail.patientcode),
	patientcode=gldetail.patientcode,
	patient = (SELECT Name FROM Patient WHERE Patient.PatientCode = gldetail.patientcode),
	guestregno = (SELECT regno FROM Guest WHERE Guest.GuestCode = gldetail.Guestcode),
	guestcode=gldetail.guestcode,
	guest = (SELECT name FROM Guest WHERE Guest.GuestCode = gldetail.Guestcode),
	Studentregno = (SELECT regno FROM Student WHERE Student.StudentCode = gldetail.Studentcode),
	studentcode=gldetail.studentcode,
	Student = (SELECT name FROM Student WHERE Student.StudentCode = gldetail.Studentcode),
	GLROWID=gldetail.GLROWID,
	GLUTN=gldetail.GLUTN,
	balance=gldetail.balance,
	foreignamt=gldetail.foreignamt,
	debit=gldetail.debit,
	credit=gldetail.credit
	
FROM
	crs_gldetail  gldetail ,
	crs_glheader glheader, 
	accounts
	
WHERE
	( glheader.clientinstanceid = :ar_clientinstanceid) and
   ( glheader.glvochcode = :ar_VochCode ) and
	( glheader.glvochcode = gldetail.glvochcode ) and
	( gldetail.acccode = accounts.acccode )
ORDER BY
	gldetail.glrowid

objects.name: c_tot_effective_balance
objects.expression: abs( sum(balance + debit - credit for all) )

objects.name: c_tot_effective_balance_type
objects.expression: if( sum( balance + debit - credit for all) >= 0 , 'Dr','Cr')
